items.briefing:
Australian and New Zealand organisations are being warned of a surge in critical security vulnerabilities, with Flashpoint also flagging that AI is enabling cybercriminals to launch attacks faster and at greater scale. Separately, a global campaign is actively exploiting a serious flaw in VMware vCenter — widely used server management software — meaning any organisation running VMware should check with their IT team urgently to confirm patches are applied.

Ransomware groups are also at record numbers globally, even if overall victim counts have steadied, so the threat landscape remains serious. **Practical tip:** Ask your IT support team this week whether your organisation's server and virtualisation software is fully up to date with the latest security patches.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs leave Australian organisations vulnerable to 85 high-impact security flaws.
